review.assessment: The change introduces a new solution.sh that attempts to slice stdin using head piped to tail, but it fails to correct the stated off-by-one error, persistently dropping the first line of every requested range. Additionally, when START exceeds END, the arithmetic produces a negative number that breaks tail instead of yielding empty output as required.

findings.at: Defect 1: Off-by-one in slice length calculation drops the first line of the requested range.
findings.defect: Defect 1: Off-by-one in slice length calculation drops the first line of the requested range.

findings.actual: tail: cannot open '-2' for reading: No such file or directory
findings.at: Defect 2: Negative tail argument when START > END causes runtime error instead of printing nothing.
findings.defect: Defect 2: Negative tail argument when START > END causes runtime error instead of printing nothing.
